item.content:encoded:
Axiom Space is expanding its workforce as it develops the next generation of commercial space infrastructure, human spaceflight services, advanced spacesuits and technologies designed to support humanity’s continued presence beyond Earth.

The company’s current careers portal lists 92 job opportunities across a wide range of professional areas, including aerospace engineering, software engineering, systems engineering, cybersecurity, mission operations, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, scheduling, technology and other specialized fields.

For professionals and students interested in the rapidly developing commercial space industry, these vacancies provide opportunities to work with a company involved in building Axiom Station, which Axiom Space describes as the world’s first commercial space station. The company is also involved in commercial human spaceflight missions to the International Space Station and the development of next-generation spacesuits for low-Earth orbit and lunar missions.

About Axiom Space

Axiom Space is a human spaceflight and space infrastructure company headquartered in Houston, Texas. Its work focuses on expanding human activity in low-Earth orbit and developing infrastructure for a future commercial space economy.

According to Axiom Space, the company is developing Axiom Station as the successor to the International Space Station while continuing to provide commercial human spaceflight services and developing advanced spacesuits for missions in low-Earth orbit and to the Moon.

The company was founded in 2016 by Kam Ghaffarian and Michael Suffredini. Its team includes professionals with backgrounds in aerospace, engineering, science, mission operations, technology, space medicine, business, law and other specialized fields.

Axiom Space has also continued to expand its international activities. In 2026, the company announced the establishment of a Switzerland subsidiary focused on international engagement in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

Axiom Space Careers: 92 Jobs Available

The Axiom Space careers portal currently displays 92 vacancies, covering both highly specialized technical positions and roles supporting the company’s broader engineering, operations and business activities.

The vacancies shown include positions at different experience levels, ranging from internships and associate-level engineering positions to senior, principal and management roles.

Some of the positions currently listed include:

1. Supplier Development Engineer

The Supplier Development Engineer position is based in Houston, Texas.

Supplier development roles generally involve working with suppliers and internal engineering or manufacturing teams to support quality, technical requirements, production readiness and supply-chain performance.

This type of position can be particularly relevant to professionals with experience in engineering, manufacturing, supplier quality, production or aerospace supply chains.

2. Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer

Axiom Space is also recruiting for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer in Houston.

This is a highly specialized software position associated with embedded systems and Linux-based technologies. Candidates interested in this type of position would generally need substantial software engineering experience and knowledge relevant to embedded systems.

3. Mission Operations Engineering Intern – Spring 2027

The careers portal lists a Mission Operations Engineering Intern position for Spring 2027.

Internships at Axiom Space provide an opportunity for students or early-career professionals in relevant academic and technical fields to gain exposure to the commercial space industry.

Mission operations work can involve areas such as spacecraft operations, mission planning, systems integration, procedures, analysis and operational support.

4. Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering Intern – Spring 2027

Axiom Space is also advertising a Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering Intern position for Spring 2027.

This opportunity is relevant to students pursuing engineering disciplines connected to aerospace, mechanical engineering, spacecraft systems or related technical fields.

5. Software Engineering Intern – Spring 2027

The company has also listed a Software Engineering Intern opportunity.

Software is an important component of modern spacecraft, mission operations, ground systems and other space technologies. Students pursuing computer science, software engineering or related disciplines may find this type of opportunity relevant.

6. Systems Engineering Intern – Spring 2027

The Systems Engineering Intern position provides another opportunity for students interested in systems-level engineering.

Systems engineering is particularly important in aerospace because spacecraft and space infrastructure involve numerous interconnected hardware, software and operational components.

7. Electrical Engineering Intern – Spring 2027

Axiom Space also lists an Electrical Engineering Intern position for Spring 2027.

Electrical engineering plays a major role in spacecraft and space infrastructure, including electrical systems, power systems, avionics, instrumentation and related technologies.

8. Thermal Analysis Engineer IV

The company is recruiting a Thermal Analysis Engineer IV in Houston.

Thermal analysis is critical in aerospace because spacecraft and space systems must operate under demanding thermal conditions. Professionals working in this area may be involved in thermal modelling, analysis, testing and system design.

9. Flight Software Operations Manager – DevOps / DevSecOps

Axiom Space is also seeking a Flight Software Operations Manager with a focus on DevOps and DevSecOps.

This position combines software operations with development, automation, infrastructure and security considerations.

It may be relevant to experienced professionals with backgrounds in software operations, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud technologies, cybersecurity or technical management.

10. Reliability Engineer

The Reliability Engineer position is another technical vacancy listed by Axiom Space.

Reliability engineering is important in aerospace because systems need to perform consistently in demanding environments where failures can have significant operational consequences.

11. Materials & Process Principal Engineer

Axiom Space is recruiting for a Materials & Process Principal Engineer.

This is a senior-level engineering position associated with materials and manufacturing processes. Candidates for principal-level engineering roles would typically be expected to have significant technical experience.

12. Associate Materials & Processing Engineer

An Associate Materials & Processing Engineer position is also available.

The associate-level role represents an opportunity at a different career stage from the principal engineering position and may be relevant to professionals who are developing their careers in materials engineering, manufacturing or related technical areas.

13. Identity Architect

Axiom Space also lists an Identity Architect position designated as remote within Texas.

Identity architecture is associated with areas such as identity and access management, authentication, authorization, enterprise security and information technology architecture.

14. Mechanical Technician

The company is recruiting a Mechanical Technician in Houston.

Technical and manufacturing roles such as this support the hands-on development, assembly, maintenance, testing or production of complex aerospace systems.

15. Senior Detection Engineer

Axiom Space also lists a Senior Detection Engineer position as remote within Texas.

This role is particularly relevant to cybersecurity professionals working in areas such as security monitoring, threat detection, detection engineering, security operations and related disciplines.

16. CNC Machinist IV

The company is also seeking a CNC Machinist IV in Houston.

CNC machining is an important manufacturing capability for producing precise components used in complex aerospace systems.

17. Mechanical Engineer

A Mechanical Engineer position is listed in Houston in connection with Axiom Space’s Portable Life Support System work.

Mechanical engineering is central to the development of spacecraft and life-support technologies.

18. Portable Life Support System Mechanical Engineer

Axiom Space is also recruiting a Portable Life Support System Mechanical Engineer.

Portable Life Support Systems are particularly important for human spaceflight and spacesuit technologies because astronauts require systems capable of supporting life in demanding environments.

19. Systems Test Engineer

The company has listed Systems Test Engineer positions at levels III and IV.

Testing is an essential component of aerospace development because complex systems must undergo extensive verification and validation before being used in operational environments.

20. Integrated Master Scheduler

Axiom Space also lists an Integrated Master Scheduler position at multiple levels.

Scheduling is essential for complex aerospace programmes because engineering, manufacturing, testing, supply-chain activities and mission requirements must be coordinated across multiple teams.

This type of position can therefore be relevant to professionals with experience in project controls, programme management, scheduling, planning or large-scale technical programmes.

Other Career Areas at Axiom Space

Although the vacancies displayed on the careers page include a strong concentration of engineering and technical positions, Axiom Space’s broader workforce encompasses many professional disciplines.

The company’s careers information highlights work involving:

  • Aerospace engineering
  • Mechanical engineering
  • Electrical engineering
  • Systems engineering
  • Software engineering
  • Embedded systems
  • Cybersecurity
  • DevOps and DevSecOps
  • Mission operations
  • Manufacturing
  • Materials and processes
  • Reliability engineering
  • Thermal analysis
  • Programme management
  • Scheduling
  • Information technology
  • Architecture
  • Research and science
  • Human spaceflight
  • Spacecraft development
  • Spacesuit development
  • Business and corporate functions

This broad range demonstrates that careers in the commercial space sector are not limited exclusively to astronauts or aerospace engineers.

Internship Opportunities

Axiom Space’s current vacancies include several internship opportunities scheduled for Spring 2027.

Among those listed are:

  1. Mission Operations Engineering Intern
  2. Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering Intern
  3. Software Engineering Intern
  4. Systems Engineering Intern
  5. Electrical Engineering Intern

These opportunities are particularly relevant to students and emerging professionals pursuing technical disciplines connected to space, engineering, software and mission operations.

Applicants should carefully review the individual internship listing because academic requirements, experience requirements, location, work authorization and other conditions can differ between positions.

Engineering and Technical Career Opportunities

A significant portion of Axiom Space’s vacancies are aimed at experienced technical professionals.

The current listings demonstrate demand across multiple engineering disciplines, including:

  • Mechanical engineering
  • Aerospace engineering
  • Electrical engineering
  • Systems engineering
  • Reliability engineering
  • Materials engineering
  • Thermal engineering
  • Software engineering
  • Embedded software
  • Systems testing
  • Supplier development
  • Manufacturing and machining

Professionals applying for these roles should expect individual positions to have specific educational, professional, technical and experience requirements.

Because Axiom Space works on human-rated space infrastructure and spaceflight systems, many positions can involve highly specialized technical requirements.

Cybersecurity and Technology Opportunities

Axiom Space’s current vacancies also demonstrate the importance of cybersecurity and information technology within the commercial space sector.

The listings include positions such as:

  • Senior Detection Engineer
  • Identity Architect
  • Flight Software Operations Manager – DevOps / DevSecOps
  • Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer

These positions show that modern space organizations require expertise beyond traditional aerospace engineering.

Space systems depend on software, networks, information systems, identity management, operational technology and cybersecurity capabilities. Consequently, professionals from technology and cybersecurity backgrounds may find relevant career paths within the space industry.

Why Axiom Space’s Work Is Significant

Axiom Space’s work extends beyond individual spacecraft or missions.

The company is developing Axiom Station, which it describes as the world’s first commercial space station. The company’s broader objective is to develop infrastructure capable of supporting sustained human activity in low-Earth orbit.

Axiom Space is also involved in commercial human spaceflight missions to the International Space Station. In January 2026, NASA announced that it had selected Axiom Space for its fifth private astronaut mission to the International Space Station, targeted for launch no earlier than January 2027.

The company’s work therefore spans several areas of the emerging commercial space economy, including:

  • Human spaceflight
  • Space station development
  • Microgravity research
  • Space manufacturing
  • Advanced spacesuits
  • Mission operations
  • Aerospace engineering
  • Commercial access to low-Earth orbit

International Opportunities and Global Workforce

Axiom Space states on its careers website that it collaborates globally with different countries and seeks people from diverse backgrounds.

The company’s international activities are also expanding. In 2026, Axiom Space announced the establishment of a Switzerland subsidiary to support its engagement across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

However, international interest should not be confused with universal eligibility for every vacancy.

Many of the vacancies currently listed are specifically located in Houston, Texas, while some are designated as remote positions within Texas. Individual job advertisements should therefore be checked carefully for location, work authorization, export-control requirements and other employment conditions.

Important ITAR and Export-Control Considerations

Axiom Space states that it complies with the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).

This is an important consideration for international applicants.

Because aerospace companies can work with technologies subject to United States export-control laws, certain positions may have citizenship, nationality, immigration, export-control or authorization requirements.

Therefore, an applicant should not assume that every Axiom Space vacancy is open to applicants from every country.

Applicants outside the United States should read the specific eligibility and export-control language contained in the individual job advertisement before applying.

Who Can Apply?

The Axiom Space careers portal contains multiple positions, and there is no single qualification requirement covering all 92 vacancies.

Eligibility depends on the particular position.

Potential applicant groups include:

  • University students seeking internships
  • Recent graduates
  • Entry-level professionals
  • Experienced engineers
  • Senior engineers
  • Principal-level engineers
  • Software professionals
  • Cybersecurity professionals
  • Manufacturing specialists
  • Technicians
  • Programme and project professionals
  • Scheduling and project-controls professionals
  • Technology and IT professionals
  • Professionals with specialized aerospace experience

Candidates should therefore identify the position that matches their education, experience and technical background and then review its individual requirements.

Educational Qualifications

Educational requirements vary considerably by position.

Depending on the role, applicants may need education or professional experience in areas such as:

  • Aerospace engineering
  • Mechanical engineering
  • Electrical engineering
  • Computer science
  • Software engineering
  • Systems engineering
  • Materials science
  • Manufacturing engineering
  • Cybersecurity
  • Information technology
  • Mathematics
  • Physics
  • Other relevant technical disciplines

Internship positions may have student or academic-status requirements, while senior and principal positions generally require substantial professional experience.

The specific job description should always be treated as the authoritative source for the qualifications of that particular position.

Nationality, Race and Geographic Eligibility

Axiom Space describes itself as an Equal Opportunity Employer and states that it does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, protected veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

However, equal-employment principles do not necessarily mean that every vacancy is available to candidates regardless of nationality or immigration status.

Because Axiom Space states that it complies with ITAR and EAR requirements, some positions may be subject to U.S. export-control restrictions.

Applicants from Africa, including Ghana, should therefore examine the individual vacancy carefully rather than assuming that nationality alone determines eligibility.

Countries and Continents

The careers information indicates that Axiom Space works internationally and collaborates with countries around the world.

However, the current vacancies supplied for this opportunity are predominantly based in Houston, Texas, with some positions listed as Remote (Texas).

Accordingly, applicants should distinguish between:

  • Axiom Space’s global international activities; and
  • The geographic and legal eligibility requirements attached to a specific job.

For applicants from Ghana and other African countries, the individual vacancy should be checked for work authorization, relocation requirements and any applicable U.S. export-control restrictions before an application is submitted.

Is There an Application Deadline?

No general closing deadline is stated in the careers information provided for these vacancies.

The listings are presented as currently available positions rather than as a single programme with one fixed application deadline.

Applicants should therefore apply as soon as possible if they meet the requirements of a particular vacancy, while also checking the individual job page because positions can be updated, closed or removed from the careers portal.

How to Apply for Axiom Space Jobs

Applicants should apply through Axiom Space’s official careers platform.

The company specifically warns applicants about recruitment fraud and states that candidates should use its official careers site to apply. It also states that resumes sent by email will not be reviewed for employment applications.

Application Process

A typical application process involves:

  1. Visit the official Axiom Space careers website.
  2. Search for a position that matches your qualifications.
  3. Read the complete job description.
  4. Review the education and experience requirements.
  5. Check the location and work authorization requirements.
  6. Review any export-control or other legal requirements.
  7. Prepare an up-to-date CV/resume.
  8. Submit your application through the official careers platform.
  9. Follow any additional instructions included in the specific vacancy.

Applicants should avoid sending personal information to unofficial recruiters claiming to represent Axiom Space.

Tips for Preparing Your Application

Before applying, candidates should make sure their CV clearly demonstrates the skills requested in the job advertisement.

For technical roles, relevant areas may include:

  • Technical education
  • Engineering experience
  • Software development
  • Systems engineering
  • Testing and validation
  • Cybersecurity
  • Manufacturing
  • Aerospace projects
  • Technical documentation
  • Programme management
  • Project scheduling
  • Research and development

For internship applications, applicants should highlight relevant coursework, academic projects, technical skills, laboratory experience, software tools and extracurricular activities where applicable.

For experienced roles, applicants should place greater emphasis on measurable professional achievements, leadership experience, technical expertise, project responsibility and industry experience.

Axiom Space Employee Benefits and Professional Development

Axiom Space’s careers information highlights a range of employee benefits and professional-development opportunities.

The company lists benefits and programmes that include:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • Telemedicine
  • Employee assistance and wellness programmes
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Paid holidays
  • Parental and family leave programmes
  • 401(k) with matching
  • Equity awards
  • International travel protection
  • Education reimbursement
  • Cross-training opportunities
  • Lunch & Learn programmes
  • Achievement and progress reviews

Benefits and eligibility can vary according to employment status and applicable company policies.

Work Environment and Company Mission

Axiom Space describes its workplace as collaborative and mission-driven, with employees working on technologies intended to expand humanity’s presence in space.

The company says its employees work alongside specialists from areas including aerospace, engineering, technology, academia and NASA-related backgrounds.

For people interested in commercial space exploration, the organization offers opportunities to participate in projects connected to human spaceflight, spacecraft systems, spacesuits, orbital infrastructure, software and other technologies.

Important Information for International Applicants

International candidates should pay particular attention to the following before applying:

1. Location

Many of the vacancies listed are in Houston, Texas.

2. Remote Work

Some vacancies are identified as Remote (Texas), which does not necessarily mean they can be performed remotely from another country.

3. Work Authorization

Applicants should verify whether the specific role requires U.S. work authorization or provides any relocation or immigration support.

4. Export Controls

Axiom Space states that it complies with ITAR and EAR requirements. Certain positions may consequently have restrictions affecting international applicants.

5. Individual Job Requirements

The eligibility requirements of one vacancy should not be assumed to apply to another. Candidates should read the complete description of each position separately.

Application Link

Interested applicants can explore the available positions and submit applications through Axiom Space’s official careers platform:

Axiom Space Careers and Job Opportunities

Official Website

For information about Axiom Space, its missions, commercial space station programme and corporate activities, visit:

Axiom Space Official Website

More internship programs visit the OFY Website HERE

Conclusion

Axiom Space is currently advertising a broad range of employment opportunities across engineering, software, cybersecurity, manufacturing, mission operations, scheduling, technology and other professional areas.

The current careers listings include opportunities ranging from Spring 2027 internships to senior, principal and management-level positions. This makes the careers portal relevant to different stages of professional development, although applicants must meet the requirements of the specific vacancy they choose.

Axiom Space’s work is centered on the development of commercial space infrastructure, human spaceflight services, advanced spacesuits and Axiom Station. The company is also expanding its international engagement while maintaining compliance with U.S. export-control regulations.

There is no single general application deadline stated for the 92 vacancies. Instead, applicants should monitor the official careers portal and apply to relevant positions while they remain available.

For international applicants, particularly those outside the United States, it is especially important to check each vacancy’s location, work-authorization requirements and any ITAR/EAR restrictions before applying.

This is an opportunity to explore careers within one of the companies working on the development of the emerging commercial space industry, but applicants should rely on the specific official job description for the final qualification and eligibility requirements of each position.
